costumes.text: Use the WAD keys to move around.
Click to punch and fight off the mobs!

Zombie: Shambles and attacks. Not       much else to say.
Wlcome! Press "space" to start and "h" for a tutorial.
To respawn, press the return/enter key!
Collect 12 Ender Eyes (    ) and you will fight the Ender Dragon for a chance to get a high score!
To gain Ender Eyes and extra health, defeat monsters!
Good luck!
The Ender Dragon is healed by the crystal. Hold the mouse button down on it to smash it!
Skeleton: Attacks from a distance       with arrows

scriptComments: Look at all these flipping dev comments I made, huh?While your here, keep these notes a secret, mmkay? For me?In case you were wondering, the Baron boss is from DOOM. Yes, the really bloody and violent one from the DOSBOX era. Yes, I did have to tone down the voilence a little.Why do you ask?

costumes.text: Controls:WAD to move aroundUse mouse to aim and click to attackGameplay:Defeat monsters to get health and ender eyes. Snatching 12 ender eyes will send you to another dimension where you will battle the final boss, the ENDER DRAGON.Press SPACE for the next page

Scoring:All enemies: 1 point per hitThe Ender Dragon: 50 points for winning the boss fightEnemies:     Creeper: WIll shamble up to you and      will explode if it gets close enough.     Skeleton: Shoots in the back with      arrows, sort of hard to hit     Zombie: Groans and walks. WIll bite      you if you aren't careful.

High Scores:Upon defeating the Ender Dragon, a high score list will be displayed. If you achieve higher than a score on the list, you will be asked for your initials. The first 3 letters entered will become your name, and you will bump down any scoreslower than your own.Good Luck! Press SPACE to close.
MOB ARENA
Credits
